exposure: previous cesarean section (scar vs. no scar)
women with uterine scars vs. women without uterine scars
cohort: 100 women with one previous lower segment cesarean section undergoing second-trimester pregnancy termination due to fetal death or anomalies
finding: Vaginal misoprostol was found to be safe and effective for inducing second-trimester abortion in women with a previous cesarean section, although the induction-to-abortion period was shorter in women without uterine scars.
mod_finding: The study specifically investigated the safety and efficacy of vaginal misoprostol in women with a previous cesarean section.
